CITIZENSHIP IN KENYA — TOPIC SYNTHESIS AND PRACTICE
====

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
----
• Say what citizenship in kenya — topic synthesis and practice means in plain words.
• Give one Kenyan example linked to Citizenship in Kenya.
• Correct one common mistake about this page.

INTRODUCTION
----

REVISION QUESTIONS

2. Describe a situation at a school compound in Machakos that shows Citizenship in Kenya, using ideas from this page.
